print("STAT:", result.stdout)

# Check the base version of bump_build
result = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "base:src/semver/version.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'def bump_build' in line:
        print(f"\nbump_build starts at line {i+1}")
        for j in range(i, min(i+50, len(lines))):
            print(f"{j+1}: {lines[j]}")
        break

The current implementation has a bug where it resets the build value after incrementing, which undoes the work.
